description: This file defines the ShoppingCartService interface, which declares methods for managing shopping cart operations such as retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and merging of shopping carts, as well as other related functionalities like shipping and eligibility checks.

classes.name: ShoppingCartService
classes.description: Interface defining operations for shopping cart management including retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, merging, and shipping eligibility.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the provided ShoppingCart object.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a shopping cart by its ID within a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by its code within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Generates a list of ShippingProduct objects based on the shopping cart items.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart is free of charges.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem from a Product and optional attributes.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes the shopping cart, likely from the current session or context.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges a user's shopping cart with a session shopping cart within a specific store.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the shopping cart requires shipping based on its items.
